macros.name: ExecuteAfterPackage
macros.doc: Executes the code after the reference package has been loaded (using \AfterAtEndOfPackage) or finally at the end of the preamble if the reference package was not loaded until then.

macros.name: ExecuteBeforePackage
macros.doc: Executes the code directly before the reference package is loaded (using \BeforePackage) or finally at the end of the preamble if the reference package was not loaded until then.

macros.name: IfDefined
macros.doc: Executes the code if the command is defined.

macros.name: IfElseDefined
macros.doc: Executes either the code in the defined bracket if the command is defined or in the undefined bracket if the code is undefined.

macros.name: IfMultDefined
macros.doc: Checks a comma separated list of commands before it executes the defined code path if all commands were defined or the undefined code path else.

macros.name: IfUndefined
macros.doc: Executes the code if the command is not defined.

macros.name: SetTemplateDefinition
macros.doc: Defines a collection of commands (a macro) with a group and property.

macros.name: UseDefinition
macros.doc: Executes the macro using \csuse if it is defined.
